{{Quote|Mister, if that's honest to goodness Vaschean rye, I'd trade a season's trappings for one little sip!|Sam Heggs, to Jeet Travis|<ref name="MosEisley" />}}
'''Vaschean rye''', also known as '''Vasch whiskey''', was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink<ref name="MosEisley" /> from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vasch]]<ref name="TEA" /> which was [[Diet/Legends|potable]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="MosEisley" /> Its smooth and strong aspects made high-quality rye expensive.<ref name="TEA" /> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Early Victories]]'' dates "[[Tales from Mos Eisley: Heggs' Tale]]" to approximately three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which equates to around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on<ref name="MosEisley" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Sam Heggs]] approached and offered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jeet Travis]] [[grumph]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] for some of his Vaschean rye. As he sat down with Travis, Heggs stated that he had not had the drink since he had been on<ref name="MosEisley" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Beta Rhama]]. Skeptical of the authenticity of the grumph eggs, believing they would have been impossible to obtain, Travis agreed to give Heggs just a swig of the rye until Heggs explained how he got the eggs. Though Travis was ultimately unconvinced by Heggs' tale, Heggs had finished the bottle of rye by the end of his story, to the annoyance of Travis.<ref name="MosEisley" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaschean rye first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Tales from Mos Eisley: Heggs' Tale]]," written by [[Bruce Jones]], illustrated by [[Bret Blevins]], and published by [[Topps]] in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 2|second issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="MosEisley" /> in [[January]] [[1995]].<ref name="Parent release date">[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 2|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 2]] indicates it was published in winter [[1995]], and as issues [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 3|3]] and [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 7|7]] were published in [[April]] 1995 and [[1996]] respectively, issue 2 must have been published in [[January]] 1995.</ref>
